title: parse_email_addrs: silent empty Vec on malformed header
description: parse_email_addrs returns Vec::new() on Err(_) from mailparse::addrparse with no log. A malformed To:/Cc: header silently drops all recipients; the article is never relayed and there is no observable signal. Maintenance consequence: silent delivery failures that generate no log entry will be diagnosed as 'the server is down' rather than 'the header is malformed'.
